findings.observation: A lettering edit made the final panel visibly smaller.
findings.rule: For local lettering edits retain panel boundaries and scale within the panel, with the original available for restoration.

findings.observation: Long dash and white outline needed distinct treatment, and an unwanted line separated Japanese columns.
findings.rule: Read back the exact displayed text and use a glyph edge stroke when requested. Remove accidental rules.

findings.observation: A hooded back view was cropped or read as an implausible neck and shoulder silhouette.
findings.rule: Check head, hood, neck and shoulders in silhouette and maintain costume and story-prop continuity.
findings.reason: Preserves the intended subject and visual continuity.

findings.observation: A spillover element and a crowd figure made the receiving panel ambiguous.
findings.rule: Check the foreground connection and the receiving panel story and character count separately.
findings.reason: Maintains panel continuity and local action.

findings.observation: A social confirmation was missed and a file chooser had remained open.
findings.rule: Ask about sharing after final page approval, wait for the chooser before clicking Attach, and verify that it has closed before proceeding.
findings.reason: Tracks the actual sharing decision and avoids blocked work.

checks.name: Installed and bundled skill
checks.evidence: Canonical skill validator passed both copies. Strict extraction verified 302 MCP files and 14 skill files. The installed copy differs by one local personal drawing preference.

checks.name: Production and build verification
checks.evidence: Compared retained production records with approved images and reviewed the v8.0.9 live authenticated MCP candidate. The target suite passed all 29 tests after the build.
